# Paper 5: ViT (2020)

*An Image is Worth 16x16 Words* · Module 2 — The Transformer era · [Track on the site](https://arubad.github.io/AI_Research_Journey/#paper-5)

## Paper and resources
- [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.11929)
- [PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2010.11929.pdf)

## Walkthrough videos
- ▶ [Yannic Kilcher ViT Walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gl48KciWZp0)

## Study approach
How 16×16 patching removes CNN inductive biases (locality, translation equivariance). Figure 7: RGB PCA filters, position-embedding cosine similarity, attention distance by depth. Takeaway: scale beats inductive bias past ~14M images.

## Break-it experiments
1. **HAND→AGENT** — Tiny ViT vs ResNet-18 on 5k CIFAR-10 images; ResNet wins.
   - Code: `experiments/exp1_tiny_vit_vs_resnet_18_on_5k_cifa.ipynb`
2. **HAND** — Zero `pos_embedding`, shuffle patches, verify the [CLS] output is identical (permutation equivariance).
   - Code: `experiments/exp2_zero_shuffle_patches_verify_the.ipynb`
